about: The official list of Tablefolk packages. Built-in entries are rebuilt by tools/registry.mjs; add yours to "community" in a pull request. Also found in the app: npm packages and GitHub repos with the keyword/topic "tablefolk".

builtin.name: Bard
builtin.description: Songs that affect everyone who hears them (an example of a skill with a code module).

builtin.name: Healing
builtin.description: Bind wounds with bandages: a slower, mana-free heal.

builtin.name: Magic
builtin.description: Cast spells from a spellbook, paid for with mana that comes back slowly.

builtin.name: Painting
builtin.description: Paints a real picture of anything with a small image model in the player's browser (tiny-sd at 512 px, or Chitra Tiny at 256 px on smaller graphics cards), and hangs it up for everyone to see. Characters with this skill are artists.

builtin.name: Thievery
builtin.description: Pick pockets: lift an item or a few coins from someone next to you.

builtin.name: Trade
builtin.description: Buys and sells: wares and prices on the state card, offers read from the customer's words, a lowest price, sales only when the buyer agrees.

builtin.name: Companion
builtin.description: Travels with the player: keeps up (run by code), helps, talks about what it sees.

builtin.name: Guard
builtin.description: Keeps watch, questions strangers, stands up to trouble.

builtin.name: Innkeeper
builtin.description: Keeps the inn: sells food, drink and beds, and passes on gossip.

builtin.name: Quest giver
builtin.description: Needs help with something: gives a quest and a reward.

builtin.name: Shopkeeper
builtin.description: Runs a shop: sells its wares at its prices, haggles a little, never under its lowest price.

builtin.name: Villager
builtin.description: Lives here: chats and shares what it knows about the place.

builtin.name: God
builtin.description: A God game: you have no body, only the village's belief and the mana it gives. Answer prayers (or not), send rain, drought, storms, fog, blessings, healing, food, lightning, plague, blight, beasts, dreams and omens, and make decrees the priest receives in a vision and the village debates at a council. Belief rises with answered prayers, kept prophecies and rewarded obedience, and falls with silence, cruelty and broken promises; villagers move between the faithful and the doubters. Runs with no model; with a brain, villagers pray, argue and read signs in their own words.

builtin.name: Hearth Spirit
builtin.description: A tiny example of the God-play extension points: two designation kinds (shrine ground in data, an offering spot in code), two powers (a golden rain on a place, a gift of bread to a character), one resource (favour) and one demand template (an offering at the shrine). Not a game: a proof that a God package can be pure content.

builtin.name: Night Watch
builtin.description: A small game as a package: a signal beacon to keep burning through the night, a keeper's job, a woodpile that runs down, dire wolves that circle while the fire burns and close in when it dies, a signal() command that calls the militia, and the captain's briefing.

builtin.name: Orchard
builtin.description: An example package for living worlds: an apple tree that runs out and grows back, an apple picker's job, and crows that raid the apple stores. Data only, no code.

builtin.name: Smithy
builtin.description: An example package with one of everything: a blacksmith role, a smithing skill, an anvil you can strike, and a little code (the smith hammers between customers; the bellows).
